_meta.title: GridWise — Public LLM-Assisted Sample Case Pack
_meta.event: BUP CSE Fest 2026 · Hackathon · Online Preliminary
_meta.description: Ten fully worked public examples for the LLM-assisted GridWise preliminary. Each case includes 1–3 operator notes, the expected machine-checkable directive interpretation, and one valid optimal 24-hour reference schedule. These are public examples only and are not hidden judge cases.
